title: Senior Customer Support Engineer
description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

About the Role

Reporting to the Manager, Customer Support Engineering, you’ll resolve customer concerns, create and improve internal tooling, and engineer solutions that help Vercel customers get the most out of the platform. We’re seeking a deeply technical engineer with relevant support experience who can specialize in multiple core domains while partnering across teams to drive great outcomes.
You’re an excellent communicator who earns customer trust, understands complex systems quickly, and enjoys digging deep to find and resolve root causes. You’re comfortable participating in an occasional weekend or holiday on-call rotation (scheduled in advance) as part of our global coverage model.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you’re located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote.

For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.
What You Will Do
  • Solve interesting, technically complex cases for Vercel customers.
  • Troubleshoot issues alongside Engineering; identify and drive fixes and mitigations.
  • Partner with Product, Solutions, and Customer Success to provide guidance internally and externally.
  • Develop and improve internal tools and scripts that increase team efficiency.
  • Specialize in a given product area (v0) and act as a domain owner within the team.
  • Improve existing documentation and create new runbooks, guides, and internal processes.
  • Assist Customer Success Managers with Enterprise requests and escalations.

About You
  • You lead by example and provide feedback to mentor other members of the team.
  • You have hands-on experience using Vercel and v0 as a platform.
  • You have modern development and architecture experience in the AI or web space (e.g., building LLM-powered apps, web services, or production web applications) and can explain these concepts to others.
  • You have prior customer support experience in a technical role: troubleshooting customer cases, writing clear solutions, and proactively problem-solving.
  • You enjoy engineering solutions to resolve root causes of recurring problems.
  • You have strong written and verbal communication; able to explain complex systems clearly.
  • You are comfortable working with a fully remote, globally distributed team.
  • You have a passion for delivering a customer experience second to none.
  • You are willing to participate in a weekend/holiday on-call rotation.

Bonus If You:
  • Have frontend development experience (e.g., React/Next.js).
  • Enjoy technical writing for public docs or developer education.
  • Have experience automating workflows with agentic services.

title: Strategic Account Manager - Customer Success
description:
At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year. 

Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year.

You:

As a Strategic Account Manager at Feedzai, you will manage the end-to-end success for a designated portfolio of accounts while simultaneously providing critical support to Strategic Account Leads and the Head of Strategic Accounts on larger, highly complex enterprise clients. You will ensure that projects and live programs deliver contracted value, run reliably, and meet the expectations of client stakeholders. You will sit within the regional Customer Success / Delivery management structure, partnering closely with Project Managers, Delivery Leads, and internal teams to track account health, drive day-to-day execution, and support overarching account strategies.

 

Your Day To Day

Strategic account & stakeholder management

  • Own the strategic relationship for dedicated accounts, serving as the primary point of contact for key client stakeholders;
  • Partner with Strategic Account Leads to align executive stakeholders and resolve complex issues for high-revenue clients;
  • Build and nurture long-lasting relationships with client stakeholders to ensure alignment on roadmap, risk, and value realization;
  • Develop and maintain joint success plans to proactively address evolving client needs;
  • Help monitor stakeholder needs and expectations, ensuring timely communication and information flow;
  • Assist in handling complex situations by coordinating with internal stakeholders and gathering necessary data to unblock issues;

Value realization & regional alignment

  • Drive value realization plans for dedicated accounts and support Leads in managing them for enterprise clients;
  • Partner with internal teams (Product, Data Science, Customer Care) to monitor solution performance (KPIs/SLAs) and recommend value-optimizing improvements;
  • Link performance data and roadmap execution to measurable outcomes such as total fraud reduction, operational efficiency, and customer friction reduction;
  • Assist in preparing QBR frameworks and performance dashboards for strategic accounts;

Value maximization & adoption

  • Partner with clients to identify opportunities for maximizing product value;
  • Develop and support tailored onboarding and training plans in collaboration with enablement teams;
  • Monitor and analyze user adoption metrics, providing actionable insights and recommendations for improvement to clients and internal leadership;

Delivery governance & collaboration

  • Partner with PMs and Delivery Leads to drive governance, prioritization, and roadmap execution;
  • Lead governance forums (SteerCos, incident reviews) for dedicated accounts; assist Leads in preparing materials for enterprise-level engagements;
  • Monitor project and BAU initiatives, tracking success criteria, risks, and timelines to manage scope and ensure transparency;

Escalation management & risk mitigation

  • Act as an escalation point for your dedicated accounts to resolve delivery issues, while assisting Leads in coordinating data and responses for major incidents on top-tier accounts;
  • Proactively identify delivery risks across projects and maintain cross-functional mitigation plans, ensuring action items are tracked and owners are aligned;

Internal contribution & continuous improvement

  • Document best practices, lessons learned, and governance improvements to drive team excellence;
  • Partner with Marketing and Leads to identify customer advocates and produce success stories;
  • Synthesize customer feedback to influence Product roadmaps and feature enhancements;

 

You Have & You Know-How

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Business, or a related field;
  • 5–7 years of experience in customer-facing roles (e.g., consulting, customer success, account management) that include issue resolution, relationship management, and stakeholder management;
  • Strong understanding of the fraud prevention space (preferably for Banks or Acquirers);
  • Experience owning relationships with enterprise accounts, ideally in the financial services sector, with a proven ability to support senior leads on large strategic accounts;
  • Ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights;
  • Results-driven with a focus on customer satisfaction and a customer-centric mindset;
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences;
  • Strong organizational skills – can prioritize tasks, multi-task, and demonstrate adaptability;
  • Project Management skills, alongside a collaborative mindset to work effectively autonomously and across teams;
  • Verbal and written fluency in English;

 

The Customer Success organization, through its Delivery and Strategic Accounts sub-functions, ensures the successful implementation, sustained value realization, and operational stability of Feedzai solutions for some of the world’s largest and most sophisticated financial institutions. In this fast-paced and open environment, you will collaborate with a globally distributed, high-performing team to deliver predictable, profitable, and scalable outcomes for strategic accounts. As a result, we're empowered to spark change every day, influencing the trajectory of our company and ourselves. Join Us!
 #LI-Remote #LI-BX1

Your First 30-Days at Feedzai:

You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one-on-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. In addition, you will have access to a ton of information to give you history, context, and all the knowledge you can handle about Feedzai and the team. Finally, you will start working on projects and collaborating on work currently being done. We can't wait to have you join the team!

Life at Feedzai Instagram

Feedzai Culture

Feedzai is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Feedzai does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. 

Feedzai will use the personal data you provide us with by filling out this form for reviewing your application and to potentially negotiate a contract with you. Your personal data will be retained by Feedzai for 24 months following your application. Please see our Privacy Notice available at https://www.feedzai.com/legal/feedzai-candidate-privacy-policy/ and https://www.feedzai.com/legal/feedzai-california-candidates-privacy-policy/ for more information on how we process your personal data.

title: Customer Success Manager - Video Games
description:
At Keywords Studios, we turn our passion for games, technology, and interactive storytelling into world-class support for the creators who shape the industry. Since 1998, we’ve grown into a global network of 70+ studios, partnering with the biggest names in gaming across every stage of development — from early concept to launch and live operations.

Our goal is simple: to be the go-to global platform for technical and creative services in the video games industry. We help teams stay agile, scale quickly, and focus on building unforgettable player experiences. With deep expertise across our industry-leading service lines and a worldwide team of specialists, we work side by side with our clients as their trusted partner, providing the talent, technology, and reach needed to bring great games to life.

If you’re passionate about driving customer success and delivering measurable impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and help our partners unlock the full value of their player engagement strategies!

Role overview

The Customer Success Manager will be responsible for driving product adoption and supporting customer retention and growth across a portfolio of mid-market clients. Working in close partnership with Account Managers, this role focuses on enabling customers to achieve their business objectives through effective use of the Helpshift platform, delivering measurable outcomes through a data-driven and strategic approach. As part of a global organization, the role requires strong cross-functional collaboration across diverse teams and cultures. The ideal candidate brings demonstrated experience supporting mid-size global gaming companies, combining strong business acumen, critical thinking, and a data-informed mindset to deliver consistent value for both customers and Keywords.

Key responsibilities:

Leadership

  • Collaborate directly with the Account Manager (AM) to manage a portfolio of customers and partner on value creation, with the joint goal of driving successful customer renewal and account growth
  • Be the Helpshift product expert from the business user perspective, becoming a trusted, strategic advisor for your customers
  • Advocate for customer needs cross-departmentally and manage issue escalation to the development team as needed

Communication

  • Work with customers to establish critical goals, or other key performance indicators that aid them in achieving their goals and demonstrating the value of Helpshift to their organization
  • Jointly with your AMs, create and present quarterly business review to your customers
  • Communicate your technical knowledge of Helpshift’s platform educating clients on best practices regarding SDK configurations, Key features and internal Dashboard administration

Analytics

  • Execute 1:many success programs to impact target customers facilitated by data and maturity of their product usage
  • Use a combination of data and anecdotes to help work through ambiguity and deliver results that benefit both customers and Keywords
  • Prepare post-meeting reports after quarterly business reviews with clear action items forming customer roadmap for the coming quarters

Business

  • Support the AM's commercial objectives by serving as the customer’s advocate throughout the duration of the contract lifecycle, from successful completion of the onboarding process to the identification and development of upsell opportunities
  • Manage several projects and customers at one time, responding as needed to high priority client inquiries throughout the day, evening, and weekend when necessary

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience supporting Game Industry customers
  • Experience managing 30–40 SMB and mid-market customers simultaneously
  • Strong team player with high EQ and a customer-obsessed mindset
  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and project management skills
  • Commercial awareness and business creativity, with a process-driven and execution-oriented approach
  • Data-driven mindset with high attention to detail and ability to act as a trusted advisor for customers
  • Ability to work through ambiguity and adapt quickly in a fast-paced, growing, and deadline-driven environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Self-motivated and able to operate effectively in a remote environment
  • Willingness to travel as required

What do we offer?

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

Phases of our recruitment journey:

  • Screening stage – We begin with an initial review of applications to assess alignment with the role.
  • Interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist – Selected candidates are invited to a conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to discuss experience, motivation, and role expectations.
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager – If your profile moves forward, you’ll be invited to meet with the Hiring Manager to discuss the role and your experience in more detail.
  • Panel interview – The final stage is a panel interview with members of the hiring team, giving you the opportunity to meet potential colleagues and further explore the role.

We aim to keep the process transparent and supportive at every step. We appreciate your interest in the role and look forward to getting to know you better throughout the process.

Our recruitment process is fully online and remote. We value each application and review every candidate individually. Our recruitment team will get back to you as soon as they can to inform you about the status of your candidacy. If you're interested in joining our team, we highly encourage you to apply.

That would be it from us - now we are waiting for your move!

title: Director, Sales Engineering
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

As data becomes the backbone of digital business and AI-driven decision-making, resilience, security, and trust are critical to customer success. The Director, Enterprise Systems Engineering leads a team of Enterprise Systems Engineers supporting strategic enterprise accounts, driving technical excellence, execution consistency, and customer outcomes. This role serves as a key connector across Sales, Systems Engineering, Specialists, Alliances, Product, and Customer stakeholders to ensure every strategic opportunity is backed by a unified technical and go-to-market strategy. You'll play a pivotal role in helping enterprise organizations navigate cyber resilience, cloud adoption, data security, and AI readiness while accelerating Veeam's growth in the enterprise market.

***Must be located in; MI, OH, KY, IN, TN, MO, IL, IA, or MN and near a major airport***

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Enterprise Systems Engineers supporting strategic enterprise customers.

  • Align Field Sales, Systems Engineers, Specialists, and customer technical stakeholders around a unified technical and go-to-market plan.

  • Drive technical strategy and execution across data resilience, cyber recovery, cloud, security, and AI-driven initiatives.

  • Partner with Sales, Alliances, Product, Engineering, and Marketing leaders to influence strategy and execution.

  • Represent Veeam in executive customer, partner, and internal engagements while driving operational excellence and business outcomes.

Technologies You’ll Work With

Data Resilience Platforms, Cyber Recovery Solutions, Enterprise Infrastructure, Cloud Platforms, AI & Analytics Technologies, DSPM (Data Security Posture Management)

What You’ll Bring

  • 15+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or enterprise technology leadership roles.

  • 8+ years of experience leading managers or senior technical professionals in customer-facing environments.

  • Proven success influencing outcomes across complex enterprise accounts and highly matrixed organizations.

  • Strong expertise in enterprise infrastructure, data platforms, security, cyber resilience, and cloud architectures.

  • Executive-level communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience leading large-scale enterprise technical sales organizations.

  • Deep understanding of AI readiness, data governance, and regulatory compliance challenges.

  • Knowledge of DSPM, data security, privacy, and risk management frameworks.

  • Experience developing repeatable go-to-market and technical engagement strategies.

title: Engineering Manager, Growth
description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Job Description

Fleetio is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Growth Engineering squads and accelerate the delivery of customer and business impact through product-led growth. This leader will be responsible for building and developing high-performing engineering teams that own activation, adoption, and monetization initiatives across Fleetio’s customer journey.

You’ll inherit an established Growth squad and continue building out Growth 2, creating a unified engineering organization with a shared growth mission, high technical standards, and a culture centered on experimentation, customer value, and continuous improvements. We're looking for a leader who views engineering as a strategic driver of growth, not simply a delivery function. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering leadership to shape strategy, identify high-leverage opportunities, and ensure our teams are running high-quality experiments that translate into measurable business outcomes.

This role requires a leader who has directly managed engineering teams running structured growth and experimentation programs and understands how to balance speed with engineering excellence and customer experience. You have deep experience with experimentation, analytics, event instrumentation, and product development. You should also be able to coach engineers on engineering quality and partner effectively with PM, Design, and Data analytics without a long ramp-up period.

If you are an engineering leader with strong technical judgment, strong people leadership skills, and experience leading growth-focused engineering teams in a B2B SaaS environment, we would love to connect with you.

More About Our Engineering Team

  • Watch our culture videos: https://fleet.io/culture
  • Engineering culture, interview process, and videos: https://www.fleetio.com/careers/engineering
  • Fleetio Go overview video: https://www.fleetio.com/go
  • More about the Fleetio platform: https://www.fleetio.com/features
  • API docs: developer.fleetio.com
  • Test drive Fleetio to get an even better feel for what we're building: https://www.fleetio.com/register

This is a remote opportunity and is open to candidates in the United States, Canada, or Mexico.

Who you are

You are an experienced engineering leader who believes great engineering teams are measured by the customer and business outcomes they create, not simply the features they ship.

You have successfully led growth-focused engineering organizations that use experimentation, analytics, and rapid iteration to improve activation, engagement, retention, monetization, or other key business metrics. You understand that experimentation is more than running A/B tests. It's about creating fast learning loops, making high-quality decisions, and continuously improving the customer experience.

You possess a blend of engineering leadership, growth experimentation expertise, data fluency, and strong people management skills.

You understand event instrumentation, product analytics, experimentation platforms, and statistical fundamentals well enough to challenge assumptions, ask thoughtful questions, and coach engineers to produce trustworthy data and scalable implementations. You have hands-on familiarity with usage and event analytics tooling such as Snowflake, Segment, Growthbooks, , or similar systems, and can partner with Product and Analytics while coaching engineers on high-quality instrumentation.

You care deeply about engineering excellence.You hold a high bar for quality while continuously improving engineering velocity. You create systems that allow teams to move quickly without compromising maintainability, reliability, or customer experience.

You have experience managing and developing engineers, setting clear expectations, sustaining team engagement, and helping teams deliver measurable outcomes. You communicate clearly, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and create clarity across multiple stakeholders.

Your impact

  • Lead both the Growth 1 and Growth 2 engineering squads against a shared growth mission and roadmap.
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to Product, Design, Data, and Engineering Leadership, proactively identifying technical opportunities, sequencing work for maximum leverage, and shaping roadmap priorities based on engineering insight and experimentation learnings.
  • Optimize engineering execution by proactively identifying dependencies, removing bottlenecks, sequencing work effectively, and ensuring teams deliver value with urgency and focus.
  • Help the teams run structured experimentation programs that improve activation, adoption, conversion, engagement, or retention.
  • Raise the bar for engineering excellence by coaching engineers on code quality, testing practices, observability, experimentation discipline, and product-minded engineering while enabling teams to ship quickly and confidently.
  • Translate experiment results, usage data, and customer insights into engineering priorities and roadmap recommendations.
  • Manage roughly 7 direct reports initially, with a model that may scale toward 8 engineers as the squads build out. Coach and develop engineers into exceptional growth engineers with strong product intuition, analytical thinking, experimentation discipline, and a deep sense of ownership.
  • Develop and mentor engineers through regular 1:1s, feedback, coaching, and performance conversations.
  • Foster a high-performing, accountable engineering culture where engineers are empowered to solve customer problems, challenge assumptions, and continuously improve how the team works. Communicate progress, risks, lessons learned, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
  • Recruit, hire, and retain exceptional engineering talent that raises the technical, analytical, and collaborative bar across the Growth organization.

Your experience

  • 2+ years of experience leading engineering teams as an Engineering Manager or technical people leader.
  • Proven experience leading engineering organizations focused on product-led growth, experimentation, onboarding, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, monetization, or conversion optimization
  • Deep experience designing and operating experimentation programs, including A/B testing, guardrail metrics, statistical significance, experiment analysis, and translating learnings into product strategy.
  • Hands-on familiarity with analytics and event-data tooling such as Snowflake, Segment, Growthbooks, or similar platforms.
  • Experience coaching engineers on experimentation, engineering quality, execution speed, and long-term maintainability.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and Analytics as a strategic thought partner rather than an execution partner.
  • Experience managing SaaS web application engineering teams; Ruby on Rails and React experience preferred.
  • Strong track record of developing engineers, setting clear expectations, and helping teams deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)

title: Framework Software Engineer
description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

As a Software Engineer on the Framework team, you will work on complex development challenges, participate in technical design within your area, and play a meaningful role in shaping how we build and scale the systems that power ExtraHop's core products. You will work closely with cross-functional partners in Engineering, Product, and Security to deliver customer-facing features that enable detection, visibility, and automation at scale. This role is ideal for an engineer who brings technical depth, exercises sound judgment independently, and is motivated to grow their impact through excellent engineering and active collaboration.

Our team builds high-performance network detection and monitoring systems that operate at scale across increasingly complex protocols and data volumes. Our services and features are written primarily in C and C++ with a focus on security, scalability, stability, and reliability. Our team is focussed on enhancing, maintaining and optimizing core components of the system and functional areas related to protocol parsing, metrics publishing, continuous packet capture and Time Series DB.

This role focuses on designing and optimizing these core systems with an emphasis on performance, reliability and deep protocol awareness. You will work on next generation initiatives including scaling and performance improvement efforts, evolution of our data storage architecture (custom to open-source based) and early steps towards a cloud enabled model.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services for ExtraHop's core Framework systems, taking ownership of moderately complex to complex features with limited guidance.
  • Work across networking layers to implement and enhance protocol support
  • Participate actively in technical design discussions, contribute to architecture decisions within your team, and author clear technical documentation for your work.
  • Engage fully in agile development processes, including sprint planning, code reviews, and retrospectives; hold a high bar for code quality and test coverage.
  • Collaborate with Product and cross-functional engineering partners such as platform , infrastructure and cloud teams to translate business requirements into well-scoped, scalable engineering solutions.
  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve production and performance issues independently; conduct root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
  • Contribute to platform modernization efforts and help evaluate and adopt new technologies or frameworks in partnership with senior and principal engineers.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and improve system observability, reliability and operational readiness.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, STEM, or a related field requiring systematic and analytical thinking.
  • 4+ years of professional experience designing and delivering production software.
  • Strong expertise in C and C++ and other languages such as Go and Python.
  • Experience developing on Linux Systems (multi threading, memory management, IPC etc)
  • Proven ability to build and maintain performance critical systems.
  • Proven ability to debug complex issues (eg. using gdb, coredumps, performance tools)
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, packet processing etc)
  • Strong command of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles, with the ability to decompose complex problems into clear, actionable engineering tasks.
  • Self-starter who can operate independently, manage competing priorities, and drive work to completion with minimal oversight.
  • Excellent collaborator and communicator with a growth mindset and customer-first orientation.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with network protocols (eg. HTTP, SMB, Kerberos, TLS, Microsoft protocols or similar)
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred) or distributed systems
  • Experience with observability, on-call practices and production systems
  • Scripting experience (Python or similar)

The salary range for this role is $145,000 - $160,000 + bonus + benefits

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

title: Partner Success Manager (EMEA)
description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

The Partner Success Manager is a key role within the Litmus Customer Success team, focused on supporting and strengthening relationships with our partner network. This role ensures Litmus partners are equipped to successfully deploy, support, and promote Litmus software using established Litmus best practices and processes.

As a trusted advisor, you’ll help partners understand Litmus product capabilities, adopt new features, follow deployment standards, and deliver a high-quality customer experience. This is a highly collaborative, partner-facing role requiring strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work with partner teams both remotely and on-site.

The Partner Success Manager reports to the Vice President of Customer Success and works closely with Customer Success, Sales, Partner, Product, Support, and Engineering teams.

Travel to partner locations will be required.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary engagement contact for assigned Litmus partners, building strong relationships across technical, implementation, and leadership teams.

  • Lead partner onboarding, training, and ongoing enablement to ensure partners are confident using and supporting Litmus products.

  • Educate partners on best practices for deployment, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support.

  • Provide technical guidance throughout partner-led implementations and customer deployments, including managing escalations and resolving complex challenges.

  • Showcase new Litmus features, product enhancements, and platform capabilities to partner teams.

  • Identify gaps in partner knowledge, technical readiness, or process adherence and develop plans to address them.

  • Monitor partner engagement, deployment quality, and overall satisfaction.

  • Gather partner feedback and collaborate with internal teams to improve processes, documentation, and product adoption.

  • Work cross-functionally with Partner, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, and Engineering teams to drive successful outcomes.

  • Travel to partner sites as needed for training, business reviews, technical workshops, and relationship-building meetings.

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

  • 5+ years of experience in partner management, customer success, implementation, solutions consulting, technical account management, training and enablement, or a similar customer-facing technical role.

  • Professional experience within manufacturing, industrial technology, industrial automation, IIoT, or a related industrial environment.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand, explain, and guide software deployment and implementation processes.

  • Experience working with enterprise software, industrial software, IIoT, IoT platforms, data platforms, cloud technologies, or related technologies.

  • Experience training customers, partners, or internal teams on software products and processes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to manage multiple partner relationships, priorities, and projects simultaneously.

Nice to Have

  • Technical curiosity and the ability to quickly learn new products and technologies.

  • Experience with Wrike.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex deployment or process-related challenges.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Partner, Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering teams.

title: Director, Product Marketing, GTM Strategy
description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Fleetio is entering an exciting new phase of growth. We've built innovative products across Maintenance, Fleet Intelligence, and our ecosystem, but product innovation alone isn't enough. Our next stage of growth depends on how effectively we commercialize those innovations and translate them into customer value, adoption, and revenue.

As the Director of Product Marketing, GTM Strategy, you'll build the operating system that connects Product, Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Customer Success, and Partnerships around bringing products to market.

This is a highly strategic, hands-on role responsible for creating the messaging, frameworks, sales plays, commercialization processes, and GTM operating rhythms that help Fleetio consistently launch, sell, and grow new products.

You’ll build the function from the ground up, and grow and lead a team focused on commercialization, GTM programs, and sales enablement.

Who you are

You're equal parts strategist, storyteller, operator, and builder.

You love turning complex products into simple customer stories that help sales teams win. You think beyond launches—you think about commercialization, adoption, pipeline, and revenue. You understand that great product marketing isn't about creating more assets. It's about building systems.

You've partnered closely with Product, Sales, Enablement, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive leadership to define positioning, create value messaging, develop repeatable sales motions, and improve how products reach the market.

You're comfortable creating the strategy yourself while also building the playbooks, messaging, presentations, and processes needed to make it real.

Most importantly, you're excited about building a function that doesn't exist today.

Your impact

GTM Strategy & Commercialization

  • Create repeatable frameworks that consistently bring new products to market.
  • Develop commercialization plans that align Product, Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Customer Success, and Partnerships.
  • Partner with Product leadership to ensure commercialization begins early in the product lifecycle, not at launch.
  • Establish scalable launch readiness processes that support both major launches and continuous product innovation.
  • Help shape pricing, packaging, and monetization strategies alongside Product, Finance, and Leadership.

Messaging, Positioning & Value Selling

  • Own Fleetio's corporate messaging framework and customer value narrative.
  • Develop positioning that shifts conversations from product features to business outcomes.
  • Create messaging frameworks for company, platform, products, industries, and strategic initiatives.
  • Build the First Call Deck and other foundational sales messaging used across the organization.
  • Develop solution narratives for key growth areas including Maintenance, AI, Fleet Intelligence, Telematics, and Partnerships.
  • Ensure messaging remains consistent across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Executive communications.

title: Customer Success Engineer, Australia
description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

At ExtraHop, we're on a mission to help organizations achieve complete visibility, real-time threat detection, and proactive security through cutting-edge network detection and response (NDR) technology. Our NDR product is a market leader, providing our customers with the ability to detect, investigate, and respond to threats faster than ever before.

We’re proud of the work we do and the recognition we’ve received, including our recent Gartner Peer Insights award, which reflects the trust and satisfaction our customers have in our solutions.

If you're passionate about innovation, dedicated to protecting digital infrastructures, and ready to make a real impact, we invite you to join our team and help us shape the future of cybersecurity.

Do you want to work with a platform and technology where you can help customers solve critical business problems? Do you enjoy and excel at building lasting customer relationships? As a member of our Customer Success team, you’ll have the opportunity to unleash your expertise to wow customers and make a difference in an exciting, growing company. At ExtraHop, we provide solutions for mission-critical business and technology problems across a vast array of industries and technologies. With us, you’ll deliver solutions that customers previously thought infeasible or impossible to solve. Join us and you’ll find we have a supportive home team, great customers, and a product that customers love.

Key Responsibilities

The ExtraHop Customer Success team focuses on successful outcomes for our customers. As a Technical Customer Success Manager, you will play a leading role in accomplishing the following goals:

  • Analyze customer requirements and promote the highest value application of ExtraHop in our customer's business environment.
  • Secure contract renewals and identify growth opportunities by assisting customers in driving successful outcomes with ExtraHop products and services.
  • Engage ExtraHop end-users to provide targeted assistance and enablement - both FTF and remote customers.
  • Assist in assessing customer needs and coordinate high-value services such as ExtraHop Professional Services and advanced training.
  • Lead and facilitate new customer’s initial onboarding and introduction to ExtraHop.
  • Assess and document customer health and maturity levels to improve customer engagement strategy.
  • Execute direct customer engagement workflows and automated processes to evangelize ExtraHop and engage a wide cross-section of our user community.
  • Partner closely with the local account team to align customer strategic goals with technical execution, driving continuous product adoption and account expansion.
  • Assist and contribute to ExtraHop’s Voice of Customer activities and provide influential input on product and service roadmap priorities.
  • Work with a diverse cross-section of ExtraHop’s business units and represent customer needs and expectations.
  • Champion customer needs and opportunities for product enhancement with ExtraHop development teams.
  • Develop and maintain Customer Success Plans documenting customer’s desired outcomes and value expectations.
  • Promote customers' use of our community platform and self-service capabilities.
  • Develop deep customer relationships across the customer organizations with key stakeholders and technology leaders.
  • Recognize organic opportunities for expansion/growth and engage the Sales team to pursue.
  • Host and conduct recurring customer meetings, working sessions, and Business Reviews with customers.
  • Operate as the nexus for customer engagement and strategy with other ExtraHop teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, and Support.
  • Delivers hybrid customer engagement through a balanced mix of remote collaboration and in-person meetings, with occasional travel as required.

Required Qualifications

We’re looking for a seasoned Customer Success Manager who can help us grow to the next level as a company. As a starting point for this position, you’ll need the following background:

  • Four-year college degree, preferably in a technical field such as management information systems or information technology.

Skills and Competencies

  • Work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Effective communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work flexibly, both with independent initiative and judgment as well as execute established Customer Success programs consistently and accurately.
  • Proficiency of networking principles (layers 2 through 4 of the OSI model) and application protocols (e.g., HTTP, CIFS,, DB Protocols such as TNS/TDS, MS-RPC, and DNS).
  • Technical proficiency in enterprise networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing/switching, network packet brokers, firewalls) and API integrations for security stack interoperability.
  • Experience with enterprise security operations, including Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows and Incident Response (IR) protocols.
  • Hands-on familiarity with firewalls, SIEM/SOAR integrations, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR/XDR), Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIP), and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and architectures.
  • Experience in major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), virtualization, and containerization concepts.
  • Experience with project management is a plus.
  • Proficient user of Salesforce.com CRM or similar.
  • Intermediate-level skills with Microsoft Excel, familiar with formulas and basic data manipulation & analysis.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Sales Engineer to play a central role in the Litmus sales cycle. You’ll partner closely with Account Executives to understand customer challenges in OT/IT integration and Industry 4.0, then demonstrate how the Litmus platform delivers measurable value. You bring hands-on knowledge of the factory floor — discrete and batch production, industrial software ecosystems, and the realities of connecting OT to IT.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead technical discovery with prospects — uncovering business and technical requirements to shape solution presentations

  • Deliver tailored product demos and solution presentations that address customer specific use cases

  • Deploy and support small pilots and proof-of-concept projects

  • Work alongside Account Executives throughout the sales cycle to provide technical depth and credibility

  • Respond to RFIs and RFPs with accurate, compelling technical content

  • Relay market and customer feedback to Product Management — gaps, feature requests, and competitive insights

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

  • 3–5 years of technical experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, OT/IT, or a

    related field

  • Experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or customer-facing technical role

  • Ability to engage credibly with both OT engineers and business/IT stakeholders

  • Comfort with scripting (Python or JavaScript) and working with APIs

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on familiarity with industrial software ecosystems — SCADA, MES/MOM, Historians, or similar

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure — Azure, AWS, or GCP — in an industrial context

  • Knowledge of databases (SQL or NoSQL) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Industry exposure in Automotive, Food & Beverage, Life Sciences, or Chemical manufacturing

  • BS/MS in Electrical, Industrial, or Computer Engineering (or equivalent experience)

Brief Overview 

The Manager of Government Compliance & Authorization will lead the strategy, implementation, and maintenance of Amwell’s federal and state authorization programs. While a primary focus remains achieving and sustaining FedRAMP High authorization, this leader will also architect the internal systems necessary to align with CMMC (Level 2/3), CMS MARS-E, and StateRAMP requirements. The Manager will mature Amwell’s government compliance program, oversee the authorization process, lead efforts to define resources and hire staff to support the program, manage continuous monitoring activities, and serve as the primary liaison with federal stakeholders and third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs). The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in FedRAMP High requirements, strong project management skills, and the ability to work cross-functionally to implement and maintain complex compliance frameworks.

Core Responsibilities 

· Lead the end-to-end authorization process for FedRAMP High, while concurrently driving alignment with CMMC Level 2/3 for DoD contracts and MARS-E 2.2 for CMS/Medicaid engagements

· Manage ongoing FedRAMP continuous monitoring requirements, including monthly deliverables, vulnerability management, and incident reporting to federal agencies

· Collaborate with engineering, security, and operations teams to develop a "comply once, satisfy many" strategy by mapping NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls to CMMC (NIST SP 800-171) and MARS-E requirements to minimize redundant engineering efforts

· Own risk management of services provided to federal agencies, ensuring compliance with High-impact baseline

· Coordinate with 3PAOs to manage security assessment and authorization (SA&A) activities, including annual assessments and significant change requests

· Develop and maintain FedRAMP authorization packages, including System Security Plans (SSP), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&M), and Continuous Monitoring deliverables

· Serve as primary point of contact for federal agency customers regarding FedRAMP compliance questions and authorization boundary matters

· Monitor and interpret FedRAMP policy updates and guidance from the FedRAMP PMO, implementing necessary changes to maintain compliance

· Build and lead a team of compliance analysts and security specialists focused on federal authorization requirements

· Create and deliver training programs to ensure organizational awareness of FedRAMP requirements and responsibilities

· Manage relationships with federal authorizing officials, cloud service providers, and other stakeholders in the authorization process

Qualifications

· 7+ years of experience in information security, compliance, or risk management with at least 3 years specifically working with FedRAMP authorizations

· Demonstrated experience successfully achieving FedRAMP High authorization for a cloud service offering (CSO)

· Deep knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 security controls, FISMA, FedRAMP baselines, and federal security authorization processes

· Experience managing continuous monitoring activities and maintaining active FedRAMP ATOs

· 3+ years of people management experience, including hiring, developing, and leading compliance or security teams

· Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure security (AWS, Azure, or GCP) in FedRAMP environments

· Familiarity with healthcare compliance frameworks (HIPAA, HITRUST) and their intersection with federal requirements

· Proven project management skills with ability to coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder authorization efforts

· Experience working with 3PAOs and understanding of security assessment methodologies

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to translate technical security concepts for various audiences

· Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CAP, or FedRAMP-specific certifications preferred

· Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field required; Master's degree preferred

· Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance if required

Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell. 

Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.  

Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are.

title: Expel: Managed SIEM Detection Engineer

Here's the work. Customers come to us with SIEMs that should be surfacing threats but are instead consuming their teams: ingestion costs climbing year over year, engineers buried in alert noise and broken pipelines, and detection blind spots leaving real gaps. You're the engineer who turns that around: authoring and tuning detection content that satisfies real security use cases, closing coverage gaps, migrating detection logic off legacy platforms, and helping optimize what customers ingest and pay for, so their SIEM becomes a force multiplier again, not a management burden.

And because this function evolves right alongside our customers and the market, the work won't stand still. Expect it to grow into deeper integrations, automated and AI-assisted tooling, and security strategies our customers need next.

What Expel can do for you

  • Give you a ground-floor seat in a new professional services function, where your expertise directly shapes the quality of what we deliver to customers
  • Provide real runway for professional development as the function grows
  • Put you on complex, high-stakes detection and SIEM problems across a wide range of customer environments
  • Let you work across leading SIEM platforms, including Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, and CrowdStrike NG SIEM, plus emerging AI-assisted tooling

What you can do for Expel

  • Deliver end-to-end professional services engagements, including detection strategy, MITRE ATT&CK assessment, SIEM optimization and integrations, SOAR playbook development, and custom log parsing
  • Develop and validate detection content that satisfies defined security use cases, at onboarding and as environments evolve, with strong coverage and clean fidelity
  • Optimize SIEM performance and cost by tuning detections for fidelity, reducing alert noise, and improving ingestion efficiency
  • Contribute to Expel's professional services proprietary detection library, continuously improving our detection strategy and capability
  • Translate detection logic between SIEM platforms and write custom parsers for standard and non-standard log sources, using AI-assisted tools where they help and validating the outputs
  • Partner with Detection Engineering and the SOC to hand off environments ready for ongoing co-managed operations, and work with SOC analysts to sharpen the fidelity and actionability of rules and alerts
  • Track the evolving threat landscape and turn it into new detection development

What you should bring to Expel

title: Toggl: Senior Full Stack
description:
Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia
URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.

You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.

The salary for this position is €83,000 annually.

You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4.

 

The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.

You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.

Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Ownership and delivery

  • Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.

  • Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.

  • Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.

Craft and quality across the stack

  • Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.

  • Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.

  • Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.

  • Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.

Working with product and design

  • Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.

  • Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.

  • Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.

Raising the bar

  • Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.

  • Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.

  • Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.

AI as core leverage

  • Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.

 

About You

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.

  • Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.

  • Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.

  • Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast.

  • Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.

  • Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.

  • Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.

  • Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.

  • Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.

  • Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.

  • Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.

  • Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.

  • Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

  • Nice to have:

    • Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.

    • Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.

    • Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.

This Role Is NOT

  • A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.

  • A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.

  • A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.

  • A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA
    team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your
    tests, or own your performance regressions.

  • A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.

  • A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.

 

The Team

We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results.

What's Happening at Toggl

Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0. One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.

 

Benefits

  • Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results

  • 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays

  • Unlimited sick leave

  • In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)

  • 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)

  • Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years

  • €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure

  • €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home

  • €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences

  • €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health

  • Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)
